sources.title: Community Living BC 2005/06: named employee remuneration and expenses
notes: Complete named employee cohort over $75,000 only. Board members, suppliers, aggregate payroll and reconciliation entries are excluded.
Published remuneration is retained as reported; amounts are payment disclosures, not an annual salary rate. Separate expenses are never added to remuneration.

Positions are not disclosed and remain null. Dashes and blank expense cells remain null; literal numeric zeros remain zero. Original names, initials and punctuation are preserved; no identity inference or cross-year name linking is made.
Both named remuneration and known expense controls reconcile exactly. No source amount was altered to balance.
Original schedule covers nine months ended March 31, 2006. Period start is July 1, 2005; the fiscal display label does not imply twelve months of remuneration.
sources.publicWarning: The original schedule covers nine months, July 1, 2005 to March 31, 2006. Disclosed remuneration is not a twelve-month annual salary rate.
